newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse index closes lower as bank falls.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse index closes lower as bank falls.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange index ended a touch lower on Friday after a drop of over five percent in Ghana Commercial Bank shares, trading volume was high.
The GSE all-share index closed at 382.64, from 385.14 on Wednesday, the last day of trading.
Ghana Commercial Bank shares closed at 550 cedis, down 30 cedis. Ashanti Goldfields climbed 280 cedis to 22,000 cedis.
Home Finance closed five cedis higher at 155 cedis, and a deal for over one million of the company's shares pushed the day's trading volume to a well-above average 1,087,550.
